# bitbucket_repository (Resource)

A Bitbucket Cloud Git repository.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bitbucket_repository" "api" {
  slug        = "payments-api"
  name        = "payments-api"
  description = "Servicio de pagos"
  project_key = bitbucket_project.platform.key
  is_private  = true
  fork_policy = "no_forks"
  has_issues  = true
  has_wiki    = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_key` (String) Key of the Bitbucket project this repository belongs to.
- `slug` (String) Repository slug, used in the clone URL. Cannot be changed after creation.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Repository description.
- `fork_policy` (String) One of "allow_forks", "no_public_forks" or "no_forks". Defaults to "no_forks".
- `has_issues` (Boolean) Whether the issue tracker is enabled. Defaults to false.
- `has_wiki` (Boolean) Whether the wiki is enabled. Defaults to false.
- `is_private` (Boolean) Whether the repository is private. Defaults to true.
- `language` (String) Main programming language, as reported by Bitbucket.
- `main_branch` (String) Name of the repository's default branch.
- `name` (String) Repository display name. Defaults to the slug.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import/state identifier, formatted as "workspace/slug".

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import bitbucket_repository.api payments-api
```
